mainEntity.name: How much does end of lease cleaning cost in Perth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prices start from $249 for a 1 bedroom unit. Your final price depends on bedrooms, bathrooms and condition, and we confirm it before we start.

mainEntity.name: What if my property manager isn’t happy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send us their list within 3 days and we re-clean the cleaning items free. That’s our bond-back guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be there on the day?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Most renters leave a key, a lockbox code or arrange access through the agent. We lock up and confirm when we’re done.

mainEntity.name: I had pets. Can you remove the hair and smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We remove pet hair from floors, skirting boards and vents. Many leases require carpet steam cleaning after pets, so add it to your quote and we’ll do both in one visit.

mainEntity.name: My move date changed. Can I rebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tell us at least 24 hours before your booking and we move it to a new date at no cost.
It’s an add-on, so you only pay for it if your lease requires it. Add it in the form and it goes on the same quote.
